sub.title: Renewals
sub.subtitle: What is about to charge you, and when each one last did.
sub.monthlyNote: What the list below adds up to.
sub.emptyTitle: Nothing charges you on a schedule
sub.emptyBody: Set up a recurring entry for a streaming app, the gym or a phone plan and this screen fills itself in with the day each one is due.
sub.cancelledNote: Cancelled — nothing more will be charged
sub.pauseBody: "{name}" makes no charge for {days} days — charges come back on {date}. Cancel it instead if you want the money to stay gone.
sub.notify.daysLeft: {name} is due in {days} days — {amount} will leave your account. Cancel or pause it before then.
sub.orderNote: Soonest charge first, and anything with no charge coming at the bottom.
sub.emptyFiltered: Nothing in this category is on a schedule
sub.emptyFilteredBody: Pick another category above to see the rest. Reminders still run for every entry you own, not only the ones on this screen.
sub.pauseBodyNoDate: "{name}" makes no charge for {days} days, and the charges in that time are skipped rather than held over. The date it charges again from is written on the row as soon as you confirm.
sub.pauseDaysNeed: Put a whole number of days in the box to go on.
sub.cancelBody: "{name}" stops here. {amount} will not be logged again, and any warning about a charge that has not happened yet goes with it.
sub.cancelKeeps: This is not an undo: the entry stays cancelled and is not offered again here. What it has already charged stays in your list with its history, and the payment itself only stops with the company.
sub.cancelled: "{name}" is cancelled. What it already charged stays in your history.
sub.resumeDoneNoDate: "{name}" is not paused any more. Nothing further is scheduled for it.
sub.gone: This entry is no longer here, so nothing was changed.
sub.errorTitle: Your renewals could not be read
sub.checked.one: {n} charge due in the next {days} days
sub.checked.other: {n} charges due in the next {days} days
sub.nothingDue: None of them is due in the next {days} days
